summary: Ids that address rows in a shared ShareDB document must come from crypto/rand; --dry-run must return before any disk read or required-flag check; and a --check style projection must answer the question instead of returning the whole plan.
reason: Wanderlog plans are one shared ShareDB document, so a time-seeded math/rand id collision corrupts another user's live plan rather than failing locally. The same shape recurs on the read side: dry-run probes that read --ops-file first, or a cobra MarkFlagRequired that fires before RunE, make the safe rehearsal path unreachable, and a check report that carries the full sections outline is larger than the outline command it was meant to replace.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test ./... pass and gofmt -l is clean; plan inspect --check drops from the full outline to a plan-scalars-plus-checks projection (~70x smaller) with --with-sections restoring it; cobra.NoArgs turns `--check counts` into a usage error instead of silently running every check; which and the MCP command mirror cover all 34 novel commands (was 3). .printing-press.json schema_version was raised 1 -> 2 by hand: no migration command exists, the field has one reader (an equality test in the press publish path), and schema 2 needs no field this manifest lacks.
